dedupe_keys.name: sector coupled gas power benchmark time dependent simulation of coupled electricity and natural gas networks

description: This record describes a gas-to-power benchmark problem, published in a February 2020 arXiv paper, for the time-dependent simulation of coupled electricity and natural gas networks. The authors present the full set-up of the underlying equations for both networks and their coupling through gas-fired generation, and motivate the choice of parameters using realistic data from the IEEE database and the GasLib suite of gas network instances. The simulation results demonstrate the applicability of the proposed approach and visualise gas-power conversion. The paper frames the problem in the transformation of the energy system, where renewable generation and demand are not synchronised in time and space and storage and transport become important. Coverage is a benchmark on IEEE and GasLib test networks. Access: the paper on arXiv, free; no code repository or licence is stated on the pages read. Caveats: a benchmark on small test systems, and reusability depends on the equations and parameters given in the paper text. It suits research on gas-electric interdependency and sector coupling, and relates to the GasLib gas network library catalogued here.
